Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! My name is Emma Johnson, and I'm delighted to hear that you'll be joining our team in the marketing department.

We're all very excited to have you on board. If there's anything you need as you settle in, or if you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out. I'd be happy to help you get acquainted with the team.

Looking forward to working with you!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
